CHN_TOP2000U_d0.name: Corporate Acquisition Likelihood Model
CHN_TOP2000U_d0.description: This dataset provides predictive rankings of publicly traded companies most likely to be acquired within the next year. It leverages both advanced natural language processing of global news articles and analysis of structured financial and corporate data, including M&A activity, proxy fights, credit risk, and valuation metrics. By combining text-based signals with fundamental indicators, the model offers percentile scores across global, regional, sector, and industry levels, as well as flags for recent corporate actions. Investors and analysts can use these insights to identify potential takeover targets, anticipate price movements driven by acquisition speculation, and inform event-driven trading strategies.

CHN_TOP2000U_d0.name: AI Equity Alpha Forecasts
CHN_TOP2000U_d0.description: This dataset provides machine learning-driven forecasts of total return alpha for a broad universe of listed equities, with prediction horizons ranging from 1 to 12 months. It includes a comprehensive set of 291 explainability factors per stock, spanning areas such as accounting forensics, sentiment analysis, business model clarity, technical indicators, credit risk, valuation models, and more. The dataset delivers both daily and weekly updates, offering granular insights into the drivers of predicted returns. By combining forward-looking alpha scores with detailed factor breakdowns, this resource enables researchers and quantitative analysts to identify potential outperformers, understand the underlying reasons for forecasts, and enhance equity selection and risk management strategies. Its breadth and depth make it a valuable tool for predicting price movements and constructing robust investment models.

CHN_TOP2000U_d0.name: Performance-Weighted Analyst Estimates
CHN_TOP2000U_d0.description: This dataset applies an enhanced version of the StarMine SmartEstimate model to a broad universe of stocks and financial metrics, leveraging analyst estimate data from IBES. It calculates a performance score for each analyst based on their historical forecasting accuracy and incorporates the recency of their estimates. By combining these two factors, the model generates "smart estimates" that are more predictive than simple consensus means. The dataset includes modules for analyst innovation, outlier handling, and time-series feature generation, making it a robust tool for identifying which analyst forecasts are likely to be most accurate. This can help investors and researchers anticipate earnings surprises and price movements, as changes in smart estimates often precede market reactions.

CHN_TOP2000U_d0.name: Analyst Estimates Base Reference
CHN_TOP2000U_d0.description: This dataset serves as a placeholder or reference point for the foundational data underlying analyst estimates and key performance indicators, without containing any actual financial or market data itself. Its primary function is to facilitate access to industry classifications and essential metadata required for quantitative research, while avoiding penalization for using common base modules in research workflows. Although it does not provide direct content, it enables seamless integration of industry and company classification information, which is crucial for constructing and interpreting analyst-driven signals and for ensuring consistency in backtesting and model development. By supporting the structural backbone for more detailed analyst and KPI datasets, it indirectly aids in the accurate prediction of price movements through proper sector and industry alignment.

CHN_TOP2000U_d0.name: China Equity Fundamentals Data
CHN_TOP2000U_d0.description: This dataset provides comprehensive fundamental data for companies listed on the China A-share market. It includes key financial metrics such as revenue, net income, assets, liabilities, and other balance sheet and income statement items. By analyzing these fundamental indicators, investors and analysts can assess the financial health, profitability, and growth prospects of listed companies. Such insights are valuable for predicting price movements, identifying undervalued stocks, and making informed investment decisions based on company performance and market trends.

CHN_TOP2000U_d0.name: China Stock Market Fundamentals
CHN_TOP2000U_d0.description: This dataset provides comprehensive, multi-dimensional information on Chinese stocks listed on the Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen exchanges. It includes market performance data at various frequencies, detailed corporate actions, and extensive financial statement data such as income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and financial indicators. The dataset covers both historical and point-in-time financials, as well as earning forecasts and notes to financial statements. By integrating market data with corporate and financial fundamentals, it enables in-depth analysis of stock performance, valuation, and corporate events, making it highly valuable for predicting price movements and identifying investment opportunities in the Chinese equity market.

CHN_TOP2000U_d0.name: China Stock Social Sentiment Scores
CHN_TOP2000U_d0.description: This dataset provides quantified sentiment scores derived from social media posts and comments related to stocks listed on the Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Exchanges. Using an AI-driven model, it analyzes the emotional tone—bullish, bearish, or neutral—expressed by investors and key opinion leaders across various platforms. The data includes metrics such as the number of likes, comments, shares, and sentiment probabilities, along with industry and company mentions. By aggregating and tracking sentiment trends, this dataset offers valuable insights into market mood and investor behavior, which can be leveraged to anticipate price movements and inform trading strategies.

CHN_TOP2000U_d0.name: A-shares Fundamental Data
CHN_TOP2000U_d0.description: This dataset provides comprehensive fundamental data for companies listed as A-shares on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges in China. It includes detailed financial statements such as balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements, along with key financial indicators, valuation metrics (like PE, PB, PS ratios), share capital structure, dividend information, and industry classifications. The dataset covers both historical and current data, enabling users to analyze company performance, financial health, and trends over time. Such fundamental data is essential for building quantitative models, conducting equity research, and predicting price movements, as it allows investors to assess intrinsic value, identify undervalued or overvalued stocks, and monitor changes in company fundamentals that may signal future price action.

CHN_TOP2000U_d0.name: Global Insider Transaction Features
CHN_TOP2000U_d0.description: This dataset provides comprehensive, structured features derived from global insider transactions, including purchases, sales, awards, and option exercises by company executives, directors, and major shareholders. It covers multiple regions and asset classes, with detailed metadata such as transaction type, insider role, ownership connection, trade significance, and post-transaction holdings. By aggregating and analyzing these transactions, the dataset enables the identification of potentially informative trades, such as opportunistic buying or selling, which can signal future price movements due to information asymmetry. Quantitative models and event studies built on this data can help forecast abnormal returns, enhance alpha generation, and improve risk-adjusted portfolio performance by leveraging the predictive power of insider activity.

CHN_TOP2000U_d0.name: Financial Market News Sentiment
CHN_TOP2000U_d0.description: This dataset aggregates and processes news articles from over 200 finance, economics, industry, and government sources, including social media and official company accounts. It provides detailed metadata for each news item, such as publication time, source, and relevance to specific companies, along with sentiment analysis and relevance scoring. The data is deduplicated, classified, and tagged with industry and event types, enabling users to track news flow, sentiment trends, and rumor responses at the company and sector level. By quantifying news sentiment and relevance, the dataset offers valuable signals for predicting short-term price movements and market reactions, supporting both quantitative and qualitative investment strategies.

CHN_TOP2000U_d0.name: China Fundamentals and Technicals Model
CHN_TOP2000U_d0.description: This dataset provides over 200 quantitative factors for Chinese equities, spanning fundamental, technical, analyst, and price-volume metrics. It includes daily updated measures such as profitability ratios, growth rates, valuation multiples, analyst ratings and forecasts, momentum indicators, liquidity metrics, and risk statistics. The breadth of coverage across financial statement data, market-derived signals, and analyst sentiment enables robust multi-factor modeling for stock selection, risk management, and alpha generation. Researchers and investors can use these factors to build predictive models, identify outperforming stocks, and enhance portfolio construction in the China A-share market.

CHN_TOP2000U_d0.name: Significant Developments Data

CHN_TOP2000U_d0.name: News Analytic Model Data

CHN_TOP2000U_d0.name: Equity Share Events Data

By linking bond market indicators—such as credit risk, yield curve dynamics, and bond-equity return divergences—to related equities, the dataset offers 19 base factors and several variants to predict future stock returns. These factors capture changes in credit conditions, market sentiment, and cross-asset relationships, making the dataset valuable for quantitative models, risk assessment, and alpha generation. Investors and analysts can use these signals to enhance equity selection, construct long-short strategies, and anticipate price movements based on underlying credit market trends.

CHN_TOP2000U_d0.name: A-shares Index Data
CHN_TOP2000U_d0.description: This dataset provides comprehensive fundamental and market data for China A-shares indices, including basic index descriptions, end-of-day prices, industry classifications, index constituents, ETF creation and redemption details, and member weights for exchange indices. It covers a wide range of financial metrics such as market capitalization, valuation ratios (PE, PB, PS), trading volumes, turnover rates, and corporate actions. The dataset also includes information on index rebalancing, constituent changes, and sector mappings, making it a valuable resource for analyzing market structure, sector rotation, and price drivers. By integrating index-level fundamentals with constituent and industry data, this dataset enables robust factor modeling, backtesting, and prediction of price movements in the Chinese equity market.

CHN_TOP2000U_d0.name: A-shares Trade Data
CHN_TOP2000U_d0.description: This dataset provides comprehensive daily trading data for China A-shares, including price, volume, turnover, money flow, margin trading, block trades, insider trades, shareholder changes, and technical indicators. It covers end-of-day prices, abnormal trades, order book statistics, and detailed breakdowns by trader type and transaction size. The data enables analysis of liquidity, market impact, order flow, and trading patterns, supporting quantitative models for price prediction, momentum, mean reversion, and risk management. By capturing both standard and unusual trading activity, the dataset is valuable for forecasting price movements, identifying volume-driven return premiums, and understanding market microstructure effects in the Chinese equity market.

CHN_TOP2000U_d0.name: Derived Industry Classification
CHN_TOP2000U_d0.description: This dataset provides a comprehensive mapping between Reuters Instrument Codes (RIC) and Bloomberg IDs, two of the most widely used security identifiers in the financial industry. By linking these identifiers, the dataset enables seamless integration and cross-referencing of data from different sources, facilitating more accurate and efficient data analysis. This mapping is particularly useful for analysts and portfolio managers who work with multi-vendor data feeds, as it ensures consistency in security identification across platforms. While not directly predictive of price movements, the dataset is essential for data normalization, aggregation, and the construction of robust multi-source trading and risk models.

CHN_TOP2000U_d0.name: Alternate Industry Classification
CHN_TOP2000U_d0.description: This dataset provides an alternative industry classification for global equities, derived from historical stock returns using principal component analysis (PCA) and robust resampling methods. By extracting significant risk factors and grouping securities into clusters of varying sizes, it offers a data-driven approach to industry segmentation across multiple regions and sectors. The dataset includes detailed mappings for top securities and supports flexible cluster sizes, enabling users to analyze market structure, sector rotation, and cross-sectional risk. This classification can enhance factor modeling, portfolio construction, and alpha generation by capturing dynamic relationships between stocks, potentially improving predictions of price movements and risk exposures.

CHN_TOP2000U_d0.name: Website Popularity Rankings
CHN_TOP2000U_d0.description: This dataset provides a robust, research-oriented ranking of the most popular websites worldwide, designed to be resistant to manipulation and volatility. It aggregates and harmonizes data from multiple sources, including DNS traffic, browser extensions, and web crawls, to produce a stable and reproducible list of top domains. The dataset includes detailed metrics such as relative popularity, ranking intervals, domain counts, and statistical measures like skewness and kurtosis. By mapping domains to standardized identifiers, it enables aggregation and analysis at various levels. This dataset is valuable for predicting price movements by identifying trends in web traffic, shifts in user behavior, and the emergence of influential domains, which can signal changes in market sentiment, consumer interest, or sector performance.

CHN_TOP2000U_d0.name: Daily Price Limit Data
CHN_TOP2000U_d0.description: This dataset provides daily information on stock trading halts and price limits for equities listed on the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Hong Kong exchanges, including constituents of the CSI 300 index. It contains fields such as security identifiers, exchange codes, trade dates, and the maximum and minimum allowable prices for each stock on a given day. By tracking when stocks hit their limit up or limit down prices, as well as when trading is halted, the dataset helps identify periods of abnormal market activity, liquidity constraints, and potential price reversals. Such insights are valuable for predicting short-term price movements, managing trading risk, and developing quantitative strategies sensitive to market imbalances.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: Corporate Acquisition Likelihood Model
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides predictive rankings of publicly traded companies most likely to be acquired within the next year. It leverages both advanced natural language processing of global news articles and analysis of structured financial and corporate data, including M&A activity, proxy fights, credit risk, and valuation metrics. By combining text-based signals with fundamental indicators, the model offers percentile scores across global, regional, sector, and industry levels, as well as flags for recent corporate actions. Investors and analysts can use these insights to identify potential takeover targets, anticipate price movements driven by acquisition speculation, and inform event-driven trading strategies.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: AI Equity Alpha Forecasts
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides machine learning-driven forecasts of total return alpha for a broad universe of listed equities, with prediction horizons ranging from 1 to 12 months. It includes a comprehensive set of 291 explainability factors per stock, spanning areas such as accounting forensics, sentiment analysis, business model clarity, technical indicators, credit risk, valuation models, and more. The dataset delivers both daily and weekly updates, offering granular insights into the drivers of predicted returns. By combining forward-looking alpha scores with detailed factor breakdowns, this resource enables researchers and quantitative analysts to identify potential outperformers, understand the underlying reasons for forecasts, and enhance equity selection and risk management strategies. Its breadth and depth make it a valuable tool for predicting price movements and constructing robust investment models.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: Performance-Weighted Analyst Estimates
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset applies an enhanced version of the StarMine SmartEstimate model to a broad universe of stocks and financial metrics, leveraging analyst estimate data from IBES. It calculates a performance score for each analyst based on their historical forecasting accuracy and incorporates the recency of their estimates. By combining these two factors, the model generates "smart estimates" that are more predictive than simple consensus means. The dataset includes modules for analyst innovation, outlier handling, and time-series feature generation, making it a robust tool for identifying which analyst forecasts are likely to be most accurate. This can help investors and researchers anticipate earnings surprises and price movements, as changes in smart estimates often precede market reactions.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: ESG scores
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides a comprehensive mapping between Reuters Instrument Codes (RICs) and Bloomberg Identifiers (BBIDs), facilitating cross-platform security identification and data integration. By linking these two widely used financial identifiers, the dataset enables seamless aggregation and comparison of market data from Bloomberg and Refinitiv sources. This mapping is essential for portfolio managers, researchers, and trading systems that require accurate and efficient reconciliation of securities across different data vendors. While not directly predictive of price movements, the dataset is crucial for ensuring data integrity and consistency in multi-source financial analysis, which underpins robust quantitative research and trading strategies.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: Estimations of Key Fundamentals
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides daily, regionally split files containing detailed and consensus analyst estimates for key financial metrics such as revenue, EBITDA, EPS, dividends, and price targets for publicly traded companies worldwide. It includes individual analyst and broker forecasts, consensus calculations (mean, median, high, low, standard deviation), and actuals, along with metadata on fiscal periods, reporting currencies, and company identifiers. The dataset is highly granular, supporting point-in-time analysis and backtesting, and is essential for identifying earnings surprises, revisions, and trends in analyst sentiment. By tracking changes in consensus and individual estimates, users can anticipate price movements driven by earnings releases, analyst upgrades/downgrades, and shifts in market expectations.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: Analyst Trade Ideas
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides a comprehensive mapping between Bloomberg IDs (BBIDs) and Refinitiv Instrument Codes (RICs), facilitating cross-platform identification of securities. It is sourced from both Bloomberg and Refinitiv, ensuring high coverage and accuracy. While not intended for general research or direct price prediction, this mapping is essential for data integration, enabling analysts and portfolio managers to link and synchronize datasets from different vendors. By ensuring consistent instrument identification, it supports robust multi-source analytics, backtesting, and the construction of unified trading universes, which are foundational for any quantitative or fundamental price movement analysis.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: Fundamental Analyst Estimates
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: The FactSet Fundamental dataset provides comprehensive annual and interim financial statement data, ratios, and per-share metrics for global companies, with coverage starting from 1980 for developed markets and the 1990s for developing markets. The dataset includes restatements, detailed line items, and standardized fields, enabling robust cross-company and cross-market comparisons. Key fields include balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow items, as well as derived ratios such as return on equity, margins, and growth rates. This dataset is valuable for quantitative and fundamental analysis, backtesting, and predictive modeling, as it allows users to track historical financial performance, identify trends, and build factor models that can help forecast future price movements based on company fundamentals.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: Analyst Estimates Base Reference
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset serves as a placeholder or reference point for the foundational data underlying analyst estimates and key performance indicators, without containing any actual financial or market data itself. Its primary function is to facilitate access to industry classifications and essential metadata required for quantitative research, while avoiding penalization for using common base modules in research workflows. Although it does not provide direct content, it enables seamless integration of industry and company classification information, which is crucial for constructing and interpreting analyst-driven signals and for ensuring consistency in backtesting and model development. By supporting the structural backbone for more detailed analyst and KPI datasets, it indirectly aids in the accurate prediction of price movements through proper sector and industry alignment.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: Global Analyst Earnings Forecasts
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides comprehensive global analyst earnings forecasts, consensus estimates, and actuals for over 60,000 companies, sourced from broker and sell-side analyst submissions. It includes detailed and summary-level data on key financial metrics such as earnings per share (EPS), revenue, cash flow, and segment-level results, as well as analyst recommendations and price targets. The dataset tracks both current and historical estimates, revisions, and company-issued guidance, with extensive metadata on contributors, accounting standards, and industry classifications. By aggregating and updating analyst expectations in near real-time, this dataset enables users to monitor market sentiment, identify earnings momentum, and anticipate potential surprises—making it a valuable tool for predicting price movements and constructing quantitative investment strategies.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: Behavioral Finance Signal Factors
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides a suite of behavioral finance-based signals designed to capture investor extrapolation bias in equity markets. It includes six key factors: three that analyze the shape and curvature of price paths, and three that identify salient patterns such as streaks in returns, extreme daily movements, and visually prominent trends. By quantifying how investors may irrationally project recent performance into the future, these signals serve as contrarian indicators and can help forecast short-term reversals and momentum effects. The dataset is valuable for predictive modeling, risk assessment, and portfolio construction, offering insights into market inefficiencies driven by psychological biases and aiding in the identification of potential mispricings and alpha opportunities.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: China Equity Fundamentals Data
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides comprehensive fundamental data for companies listed on the China A-share market. It includes key financial metrics such as revenue, net income, assets, liabilities, and other balance sheet and income statement items. By analyzing these fundamental indicators, investors and analysts can assess the financial health, profitability, and growth prospects of listed companies. Such insights are valuable for predicting price movements, identifying undervalued stocks, and making informed investment decisions based on company performance and market trends.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: China Equity Index Constituents
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides comprehensive information on the levels and constituents of a major Chinese equity index, including constituent weights, free float shares, divisors, and corporate actions. By tracking changes in index composition and constituent metrics, analysts can gain insights into market trends, sector rotations, and the impact of corporate actions on index performance. Such data is valuable for building quantitative models, benchmarking portfolios, and predicting price movements based on shifts in index structure and constituent dynamics.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: China Stock Market Fundamentals
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides comprehensive, multi-dimensional information on Chinese stocks listed on the Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen exchanges. It includes market performance data at various frequencies, detailed corporate actions, and extensive financial statement data such as income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and financial indicators. The dataset covers both historical and point-in-time financials, as well as earning forecasts and notes to financial statements. By integrating market data with corporate and financial fundamentals, it enables in-depth analysis of stock performance, valuation, and corporate events, making it highly valuable for predicting price movements and identifying investment opportunities in the Chinese equity market.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: China Stock Social Sentiment Scores
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides quantified sentiment scores derived from social media posts and comments related to stocks listed on the Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Exchanges. Using an AI-driven model, it analyzes the emotional tone—bullish, bearish, or neutral—expressed by investors and key opinion leaders across various platforms. The data includes metrics such as the number of likes, comments, shares, and sentiment probabilities, along with industry and company mentions. By aggregating and tracking sentiment trends, this dataset offers valuable insights into market mood and investor behavior, which can be leveraged to anticipate price movements and inform trading strategies.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: Price Chart Continuation Pattern Similarity
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides daily, per-stock similarity scores that measure how closely a stock’s price chart matches well-known continuation-style technical patterns, such as flags, pennants, rectangles, channels, scallops, staircases, cup-and-handle, and gap formations. The scores are derived by comparing chart-image embeddings to a curated library of canonical continuation patterns using advanced machine learning techniques. Multiple summary statistics (mean, median, max, dynamic, etc.) are available across different time horizons and regions, enabling flexible analysis. These similarity scores can be used to identify stocks likely to resume their current trend after consolidation, support trend-following strategies, and enhance alpha generation by confirming or filtering trading signals. The dataset is particularly valuable for quantitative researchers seeking to incorporate pattern-based insights into predictive models for price movement forecasting.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: Corporate Event Driven Stock Model
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides a systematic stock-selection model that leverages corporate event data and machine learning techniques to predict future stock returns. It incorporates a wide range of event types, such as earnings announcements, executive changes, product launches, and structural corporate actions, and processes them using advanced feature engineering and algorithms like elastic net and xgBoost. The model outputs normalized scores and ranks for stocks based on the predictive impact of these events, enabling users to identify potential alpha opportunities and construct long/short portfolios. By capturing both fundamental and behavioral signals from event-driven market reactions, the dataset is valuable for forecasting price movements, managing risk, and enhancing quantitative investment strategies.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: Global Institutional Fund Holdings
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides daily, account-level insights into the holdings and transactions of major institutional investors, including mutual funds, ETFs, asset managers, pension funds, and insurance companies. It features detailed tables on daily trades, holdings, and the size of the investment account panel, with metrics such as conviction holdings, boundary trades, significant transactions, and concentration measures. By tracking changes in institutional ownership, trade activity, and portfolio concentration, the dataset enables users to identify shifts in market sentiment, detect accumulation or liquidation trends, and assess the impact of large fund movements on individual securities. These insights are valuable for predicting price movements, understanding liquidity dynamics, and generating alpha through analysis of institutional behavior.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: Fundamental Point in Time Data
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides point-in-time, globally standardized fundamental financial data for over 60,000 companies, including both active and inactive firms, with daily granularity. It includes original and restated values for income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements, as well as business and geographic segment data, ratios, and company metadata. The point-in-time structure eliminates forward-looking and survivorship biases, enabling accurate historical backtesting and model development. With coverage dating back to 1989 for US companies and 1997 for non-US, this dataset is essential for constructing robust factor models, event studies, and alpha signals based on true historical financials, supporting reliable prediction of price movements and risk assessment.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: China Fundamentals

The data is systematically collected and standardized, offering both historical and point-in-time (PIT) coverage. This rich set of financial indicators enables in-depth analysis of company performance, sector trends, and valuation metrics, making it highly valuable for predicting price movements, constructing factor models, and supporting both quantitative and fundamental investment strategies in the Hong Kong equity market.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: Company Fundamental Data for Equity
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides comprehensive, point-in-time global company fundamental data, capturing daily snapshots of financial statements, balance sheets, cash flows, and key ratios as they were known to the market at each historical date. It includes restatements, amendments, and all changes, ensuring accurate backtesting and minimizing look-ahead bias. The dataset covers a wide range of standardized and normalized financial metrics across regions and industries, making it a critical resource for quantitative research, factor modeling, and alpha generation. By reflecting the true information set available to investors at any given time, it enables robust prediction of price movements and supports the development of systematic investment strategies.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides comprehensive, structured features derived from global insider transactions, including purchases, sales, awards, and option exercises by company executives, directors, and major shareholders. It covers multiple regions and asset classes, with detailed metadata such as transaction type, insider role, ownership connection, trade significance, and post-transaction holdings. By aggregating and analyzing these transactions, the dataset enables the identification of potentially informative trades, such as opportunistic buying or selling, which can signal future price movements due to information asymmetry. Quantitative models and event studies built on this data can help forecast abnormal returns, enhance alpha generation, and improve risk-adjusted portfolio performance by leveraging the predictive power of insider activity.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: CSI1000 and Risk Data
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides comprehensive information on the CSI 500 Index, which tracks 500 mid-cap A-share companies listed on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges in China. It includes index levels, constituent lists, constituent weights, free float shares, market capitalization, sector and industry breakdowns, and details on corporate actions such as dividends, rights issues, and share changes. The dataset is valuable for analyzing the performance and structure of the Chinese mid-cap equity market, constructing custom portfolios, and monitoring sector rotation and market trends. By offering granular data on index composition and historical changes, it enables users to assess market breadth, liquidity, and the impact of corporate events, which are critical for predicting price movements and developing quantitative investment strategies.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: Financial Market News Sentiment
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset aggregates and processes news articles from over 200 finance, economics, industry, and government sources, including social media and official company accounts. It provides detailed metadata for each news item, such as publication time, source, and relevance to specific companies, along with sentiment analysis and relevance scoring. The data is deduplicated, classified, and tagged with industry and event types, enabling users to track news flow, sentiment trends, and rumor responses at the company and sector level. By quantifying news sentiment and relevance, the dataset offers valuable signals for predicting short-term price movements and market reactions, supporting both quantitative and qualitative investment strategies.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: Multi Factor Model Universal Output
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides the output of proprietary multi-factor risk models in a standardized format compatible with widely used risk models such as Barra and Uber. It enables portfolio managers and researchers to access daily, point-in-time factor exposures, risk estimates, and groupings for US equities, facilitating integration with simulation and portfolio construction tools. The dataset leverages advanced machine learning clustering techniques on company fundamentals and price data to create robust, dynamically updated groupings that capture stock co-movement and risk structure beyond static sector classifications. By offering comprehensive, daily-updated risk model outputs, this dataset supports more accurate risk control, portfolio optimization, and alpha signal neutralization, ultimately helping users better predict and manage price movements and portfolio risk.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: Alternative technical factor models
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides a comprehensive mapping between Bloomberg IDs (BBID) and Refinitiv Instrument Codes (RIC), enabling seamless integration and cross-referencing of securities across major financial data platforms. By facilitating accurate instrument identification, it supports data normalization and aggregation from multiple sources, which is essential for building robust multi-source trading models, conducting security-level research, and ensuring consistency in price and volume analytics. While not directly predictive, this mapping is a foundational resource for linking datasets that can be used to forecast price movements and enhance quantitative research workflows.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: Stock Selection from Accounting-based Factors
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset contains a comprehensive suite of Performance Deviation Index (PDI) factors derived from 14 key accounting variables, designed to measure the deviation of a company's latest financial metrics from its historical averages. The dataset includes composite models, quality-focused variants, and sector-neutralized signals, all constructed using advanced techniques such as risk parity weighting, deseasonalization, and clustering. By capturing anomalies and behavioral biases in financial statement data, these factors have demonstrated superior risk-adjusted returns compared to traditional accounting ratios and growth metrics. The dataset is valuable for quantitative investors seeking to enhance stock selection, improve portfolio diversification, and boost predictive power for price movements across global equity markets.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: Quant Model Data
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset aggregates a wide range of quantitative metrics and valuation models, focusing on consensus estimates, analyst ratings, institutional forecasts, and historical price data. It includes detailed fields for changes in consensus estimates over various timeframes, analyst sentiment indices, earnings forecasts, valuation ratios, and composite scores that rank securities against their peers. The data is structured to provide insights into market expectations, analyst sentiment, and valuation momentum, making it highly valuable for predicting price movements by identifying securities with strong upward or downward consensus trends, rating changes, and valuation gaps. The comprehensive nature of the dataset allows for robust cross-sectional analysis and can be used to enhance predictive models for stock selection and timing.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: Stock Selection DL model
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides the outputs of a next-generation deep learning model designed for global stock selection with a focus on statistical arbitrage and mean reversion alpha. It includes both raw and processed model scores, updated daily and with monthly historical data, covering a broad universe of equities across multiple regions. The model leverages advanced neural network architectures such as CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, transformers, and conformers, and is engineered to be interpretable and relatively uncorrelated with common equity style factors. The dataset is particularly valuable for systematic and high-frequency trading strategies, as it offers timely, actionable signals that can be used to enhance portfolio construction, manage risk, and exploit short-term price inefficiencies. By providing robust, data-driven alpha signals, this dataset can help predict price movements and improve trading performance.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: Asia Technical and Fundamental ranking model
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides comprehensive daily fundamental analysis and equity ratings for over 40,000 companies across Asian markets. It includes a wide range of metrics such as implied valuation, price ranges, relative valuation to peers, share price performance classifications, and detailed breakdowns of operating models, earnings leverage, margin drivers, and growth expectations. The dataset also covers corporate actions like dividend changes, share buybacks, and M&A activity, as well as assessments of accounting quality, dividend quality, and sustainability of returns. By offering both quantitative scores and qualitative classifications, this dataset enables investors and analysts to identify undervalued or overvalued stocks, spot companies with strong or deteriorating fundamentals, and anticipate potential price movements based on changes in financial health, corporate actions, and peer-relative performance.

CHN_TOP2000U_d1.name: China Fundamentals and Technicals Model
CHN_TOP2000U_d1.description: This dataset provides over 200 quantitative factors for Chinese equities, spanning fundamental, technical, analyst, and price-volume metrics. It includes daily updated measures such as profitability ratios, growth rates, valuation multiples, analyst ratings and forecasts, momentum indicators, liquidity metrics, and risk statistics. The breadth of coverage across financial statement data, market-derived signals, and analyst sentiment enables robust multi-factor modeling for stock selection, risk management, and alpha generation. Researchers and investors can use these factors to build predictive models, identify outperforming stocks, and enhance portfolio construction in the China A-share market.

By offering early insights into market sentiment, liquidity, and potential trading opportunities, this dataset can help analysts anticipate price movements and identify actionable trends prior to regular trading hours.

The data is cleaned and segmented for ease of use, with meta data and simple sentiment indicators for each event. By analyzing the tone and sentiment of management and analyst interactions, investors can gauge market expectations, management confidence, and potential red flags, making this dataset valuable for predicting short-term price movements and identifying alpha opportunities around key corporate events.

EUR_TOP2500_d0.name: Individual Investor Transactions Data

EUR_TOP2500_d0.name: Intermediate Cluster Groups
EUR_TOP2500_d0.description: This dataset compiles relationship scores between companies using textual analysis of regulatory filings such as Form 10-K, Form 20-F, Def-14A, and streetevents transcripts. The dataset is particularly useful for identifying strategic partnerships, competitive threats, and supply chain links, which can influence price movements and inform event-driven trading strategies.

EUR_TOP2500_d0.name: Corporate Bond Pricing Data
EUR_TOP2500_d0.description: This dataset provides a comprehensive suite of equity signals derived from corporate bond pricing data, including z-spread curves, term spreads, and principal component analysis factors such as shift, tilt, and twist. By linking bond market indicators—such as credit risk, yield curve dynamics, and bond-equity return divergences—to related equities, the dataset offers 19 base factors and several variants to predict future stock returns. These factors capture changes in credit conditions, market sentiment, and cross-asset relationships, making the dataset valuable for quantitative models, risk assessment, and alpha generation. Investors and analysts can use these signals to enhance equity selection, construct long-short strategies, and anticipate price movements based on underlying credit market trends.

EUR_TOP2500_d0.name: Daily Spot and Cross Rate Data
EUR_TOP2500_d0.description: This dataset provides comprehensive, standardized global company fundamental data, covering 96% of global market capitalization. It includes annual and interim/quarterly financial statements, per share data, calculated ratios, pricing, and textual information for over 1500 data items. The data is point-in-time, capturing values as they were known historically, and supports peer comparability across regions and industries. With detailed income statements, balance sheets, cash flows, and supplemental metrics, this dataset enables robust analysis of company financial health, valuation, profitability, and risk. It is highly valuable for quantitative research, backtesting, and building predictive models to forecast price movements based on changes in fundamentals, financial ratios, and corporate actions.

EUR_TOP2500_d0.name: Derived Industry Classification
EUR_TOP2500_d0.description: This dataset provides a comprehensive mapping between Reuters Instrument Codes (RIC) and Bloomberg IDs, two of the most widely used security identifiers in the financial industry. By linking these identifiers, the dataset enables seamless integration and cross-referencing of data from different sources, facilitating more accurate and efficient data analysis. This mapping is particularly useful for analysts and portfolio managers who work with multi-vendor data feeds, as it ensures consistency in security identification across platforms. While not directly predictive of price movements, the dataset is essential for data normalization, aggregation, and the construction of robust multi-source trading and risk models.

EUR_TOP2500_d0.name: Alternate Industry Classification
EUR_TOP2500_d0.description: This dataset provides an alternative industry classification for global equities, derived from historical stock returns using principal component analysis (PCA) and robust resampling methods. By extracting significant risk factors and grouping securities into clusters of varying sizes, it offers a data-driven approach to industry segmentation across multiple regions and sectors. The dataset includes detailed mappings for top securities and supports flexible cluster sizes, enabling users to analyze market structure, sector rotation, and cross-sectional risk. This classification can enhance factor modeling, portfolio construction, and alpha generation by capturing dynamic relationships between stocks, potentially improving predictions of price movements and risk exposures.

EUR_TOP2500_d0.name: Specific Return Dataset
EUR_TOP2500_d0.description: This dataset provides daily specific returns for global equities, calculated using a proprietary risk model that extends the Barra framework with additional style and industry factors. The data includes returns orthogonal to risk model factors, representing the idiosyncratic or residual component of asset performance. Coverage spans multiple regions and universes, with fields such as Bloomberg ID and specific return percentage. By decomposing total returns into factor-driven and residual parts, this dataset enables researchers and portfolio managers to isolate stock-specific movements, assess alpha generation, and improve risk-adjusted forecasting of price changes.

EUR_TOP2500_d0.name: Aggregated dataset
EUR_TOP2500_d0.description: This dataset provides proprietary, quantitative ratings that measure non-financial statement factors—such as management quality, environmental impact, employee well-being, diversity, and trust—across 4,500 global securities. The ratings are structured around six pillars: management, health, wealth, earth, equality, and trust, and are designed to capture intangible drivers of cash flow, risk, and valuation. By quantifying ESG and sustainability factors into a 0-100 score, the dataset enables investors to assess companies’ human impact and profit potential, identify leaders and laggards in sustainability, and integrate these insights into investment models. The data can be used to predict price movements by identifying companies with strong or improving ESG profiles, which are increasingly linked to superior risk-adjusted returns and lower downside risk.

EUR_TOP2500_d0.name: Multi-Domain Quantitative Factor Library
EUR_TOP2500_d0.description: This dataset is a comprehensive library of quantitative factors designed for stock selection and risk modeling across global equities. It integrates hundreds of signals derived from regulatory filings, institutional ownership, sector-specific metrics, technical indicators, sentiment analysis, patent data, and alternative sources. The factors span multiple domains, including banking, technology, real estate, health care, and energy, and leverage both numerical and textual data using advanced techniques such as natural language processing and network analysis. By providing diverse, uncorrelated signals and sector-specific insights, the dataset enables investors and researchers to enhance alpha generation, improve risk management, and develop robust predictive models for price movements in various market environments.

EUR_TOP2500_d0.name: Securities Lending Insight Data
EUR_TOP2500_d0.description: This dataset provides a comprehensive mapping between Reuters Instrument Codes (RIC) and Bloomberg Identifiers (BBID) for global securities. It enables seamless integration and reconciliation of security data across different financial platforms and data sources. By facilitating accurate cross-referencing, the dataset supports portfolio management, trade processing, and data aggregation tasks. While not directly predictive of price movements, it is essential for ensuring data integrity and consistency when combining datasets for quantitative research, risk analysis, and multi-source analytics.

EUR_TOP2500_d0.name: Rapid Search Interest Signals
EUR_TOP2500_d0.description: This dataset captures real-time search interest data for specific companies and regions, using a standardized algorithm to transform hourly search trends into a continuous, unbounded metric. By estimating daily search activity from high-frequency data and providing a confidence score for each estimate, it enables timely detection of shifts in public attention or sentiment. Such rapid changes in search volume can serve as early indicators of market-moving events, news, or shifts in investor sentiment, making the dataset valuable for predicting short-term price movements and generating alpha signals.

EUR_TOP2500_d0.name: Webpage Views  Data
EUR_TOP2500_d0.description: This dataset tracks daily Wikipedia page views for a global universe of companies, including both parent entities and their subsidiaries. By aggregating user interest across multiple languages and linking subsidiary activity to parent companies, it provides a unique measure of public attention and sentiment. Spikes or changes in page views can signal increased market interest, news events, or shifts in company visibility, which may precede trading activity or price movements. The dataset is especially useful for generating alternative sentiment signals and for event-driven trading strategies, as it captures real-time shifts in public focus that are not reflected in traditional financial data.

By systematically capturing shifts in market sentiment and event novelty, the dataset enables researchers and investors to identify potential price-moving signals, enhance alpha generation, and improve risk management. Its comprehensive coverage and advanced scoring methodology make it a valuable resource for predicting short-term and medium-term asset returns based on news-driven market dynamics.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Performance-Weighted Analyst Estimates

It calculates a performance score for each analyst based on their historical forecasting accuracy and incorporates the recency of their estimates. By combining these two factors, the model generates "smart estimates" that are more predictive than simple consensus means. The dataset includes modules for analyst innovation, outlier handling, and time-series feature generation, making it a robust tool for identifying which analyst forecasts are likely to be most accurate. This can help investors and researchers anticipate earnings surprises and price movements, as changes in smart estimates often precede market reactions.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Information on board of director
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset aggregates and harmonizes board and executive data from multiple leading sources, providing a comprehensive view of board composition, director profiles, and inter-company board connections across global public companies. By capturing both point-in-time and historical changes, the dataset enables analysis of boardroom dynamics, governance quality, and the flow of information or influence between companies. Such insights are valuable for predicting price movements, as changes in board composition, director turnover, and network centrality have been empirically linked to firm performance, risk, and event-driven returns (e.g., M&A, CEO turnover). The dataset is particularly useful for quantitative and fundamental investors seeking to incorporate governance and human capital signals into their investment process.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Analyst Trade Ideas

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Fundamental Analyst Estimates
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: The FactSet Fundamental dataset provides comprehensive annual and interim financial statement data, ratios, and per-share metrics for global companies, with coverage starting from 1980 for developed markets and the 1990s for developing markets. The dataset includes restatements, detailed line items, and standardized fields, enabling robust cross-company and cross-market comparisons. Key fields include balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow items, as well as derived ratios such as return on equity, margins, and growth rates. This dataset is valuable for quantitative and fundamental analysis, backtesting, and predictive modeling, as it allows users to track historical financial performance, identify trends, and build factor models that can help forecast future price movements based on company fundamentals.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Analyst Estimates Base Reference
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset serves as a placeholder or reference point for the foundational data underlying analyst estimates and key performance indicators, without containing any actual financial or market data itself. Its primary function is to facilitate access to industry classifications and essential metadata required for quantitative research, while avoiding penalization for using common base modules in research workflows. Although it does not provide direct content, it enables seamless integration of industry and company classification information, which is crucial for constructing and interpreting analyst-driven signals and for ensuring consistency in backtesting and model development. By supporting the structural backbone for more detailed analyst and KPI datasets, it indirectly aids in the accurate prediction of price movements through proper sector and industry alignment.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Standardized Analyst Consensus Forecasts
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset provides standardized, cleaned, and event-aligned analyst consensus forecasts and actuals for global equities, enabling direct comparison across companies and time. It aggregates and harmonizes consensus data from multiple leading sources, including I/B/E/S, Capital IQ, and FactSet, and applies rigorous data cleaning to remove expired or irrelevant forecasts. The dataset supports flexible configuration for different forecast horizons (quarterly, annual, rolling) and includes both forecast and actual values, as well as surprise calculations. By offering time-series event data with consistent methodology, it allows users to track revisions, analyze forecast accuracy, and construct robust quantitative models. This makes it a valuable resource for predicting price movements, backtesting strategies, and understanding market expectations versus realized outcomes.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Global Analyst Earnings Forecasts
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset provides comprehensive global analyst earnings forecasts, consensus estimates, and actuals for over 60,000 companies, sourced from broker and sell-side analyst submissions. It includes detailed and summary-level data on key financial metrics such as earnings per share (EPS), revenue, cash flow, and segment-level results, as well as analyst recommendations and price targets. The dataset tracks both current and historical estimates, revisions, and company-issued guidance, with extensive metadata on contributors, accounting standards, and industry classifications. By aggregating and updating analyst expectations in near real-time, this dataset enables users to monitor market sentiment, identify earnings momentum, and anticipate potential surprises—making it a valuable tool for predicting price movements and constructing quantitative investment strategies.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Global Analyst Factor Signals
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset provides a comprehensive suite of analyst-derived quantitative factors and indicators for global equities, constructed using standardized methodologies. It leverages consensus estimates, actuals, and revision data from multiple sources to generate a wide range of predictive signals, such as estimate momentum, earnings surprise, and analyst recommendation trends. The dataset is designed to be comparable across regions and time, with rigorous data cleaning and normalization. By offering both raw and composite factors—similar to those used in established quantitative models—this resource enables users to systematically test and implement alpha strategies, enhance risk models, and improve the forecasting of price movements based on analyst behavior and expectations.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Multi Horizon Analyst Revision Signals
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset provides decomposed analyst revision signals across short, medium, and long time horizons, derived from a comprehensive analyst revision-based stock ranking model. By applying advanced signal processing techniques, it extracts horizon-specific components from a wide array of analyst-driven metrics, such as earnings estimate changes, recommendation shifts, and predicted surprises. The resulting fields enable researchers and investors to isolate and analyze the impact of analyst sentiment and estimate revisions over different time frames, enhancing the ability to identify timely alpha opportunities and anticipate price movements driven by changes in analyst outlook. This multi-horizon approach is particularly valuable for constructing and testing trading strategies that are sensitive to the timing and persistence of analyst-driven signals.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Deep Learning Chart-Based Alpha
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset leverages deep learning to predict future stock returns by mimicking the decision-making process of retail traders who analyze price charts. It transforms time series financial data into images (such as OHLC or other chart types) and applies pre-trained convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to these images to generate return forecasts. The output includes both raw return predictions and quantile-based relative return rankings, along with associated probabilities. By capturing complex visual patterns and technical signals that may be overlooked by traditional quantitative models, this approach can identify non-linear relationships and subtle chart features that are predictive of price movements. The dataset is particularly useful for developing and testing alpha models that seek to exploit behavioral and technical trading signals, offering a novel perspective that complements standard factor-based or fundamental models.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Deep Learning Risk Free Returns
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset leverages deep learning techniques to predict risk-free returns by transforming time series price and volume data into 2D chart images, which are then analyzed using pre-trained convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The dataset includes predictions for multiple time horizons (such as 5, 10, 20, and 50 days) and provides both raw and relative return forecasts, along with quantile rankings and associated probabilities. By simulating a retail trader’s perspective through chart-based analysis, this dataset offers a unique, high-dimensional approach to forecasting future returns with minimal risk. It is particularly useful for identifying low-risk trading opportunities and enhancing portfolio construction by providing robust, model-driven signals that can help anticipate price movements in a risk-averse manner.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Earnings Date Data

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Earnings Date Breaks

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: International Findings Data

It provides detailed metadata such as event status, timing, fiscal period, and confirmation level, along with links to press releases and filings. By tracking the timing and revisions of earnings dates, dividend actions, and other corporate events, the dataset enables researchers and traders to anticipate market-moving disclosures, identify signals of management intent, and exploit calendar-based trading strategies. GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Horizon Earnings and Calendar North America
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset provides concise, real-time summaries of major company news events that are likely to impact market prices. Each event is tagged by topic, significance level, and includes a headline and detailed description, covering a wide range of corporate actions such as mergers, acquisitions, product launches, regulatory changes, earnings guidance, and more. The data is structured for easy integration into quantitative models, allowing users to filter by region, industry, and event type. By focusing on high-impact developments and filtering out less relevant news, this dataset enables analysts and traders to quickly identify actionable events, perform historical trend analysis, and enhance event-driven trading strategies to better predict price movements.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Global Earnings Call Sentiment Matrix
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset provides a structured, matrix-format aggregation of global company earnings call transcripts, focusing on sentiment and topic analytics. It leverages advanced natural language processing to extract and quantify positive, neutral, and negative sentiment probabilities from management presentations and Q&A sessions, across over 200 thematic topics. The data is filtered and enhanced with smart aggregation techniques, including rolling and daily sentiment measures, confidence scores, and relevance indicators. By capturing nuanced shifts in management tone and analyst reactions, the dataset enables researchers and investors to identify patterns and signals that may precede price movements, offering valuable insights for predictive modeling and alpha generation in equity markets.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Text-Based Event Relationship Analysis
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset leverages advanced language models to extract and classify relationships between companies, events, and entities from unstructured text sources such as news articles, press releases, and corporate communications. By identifying the types and directions of these relationships, the dataset provides structured insights into how companies interact, form alliances, or respond to market developments. This information is valuable for predicting price movements, as changes in company relationships—such as mergers, partnerships, or competitive actions—often precede significant market reactions. The dataset enhances traditional event-driven strategies by offering a deeper, more nuanced understanding of the connections and influences within the market ecosystem.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Corporate Event Sentiment Signals
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset provides structured sentiment analysis and key driver metrics derived from corporate event transcripts, including earnings calls, company presentations, analyst/investor days, and guidance calls. It covers a global universe of public companies, with detailed metadata such as industry classification, identifiers, event timestamps, and document sections. The dataset quantifies sentiment at multiple granularities—overall, by section, and by key topic—using scores based on positive and negative event counts, polarity, and word counts. By capturing management and analyst tone, margin and pricing power sentiment, and deception signals, it enables investors and researchers to assess market expectations, information asymmetry, and the impact of qualitative disclosures on price movements. These insights can be used to forecast earnings surprises, volatility, and post-event price drift, supporting both discretionary and quantitative investment strategies.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Transformer Based Financial News Scores
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset provides daily sentiment and relevance scores for financial news articles using a custom transformer-based natural language processing model. It processes real-time news feeds, extracting and quantifying sentiment, significance, and company-level impact in a structured matrix format. By bridging the gap between raw news data and actionable signals, the dataset enables researchers and portfolio managers to efficiently identify market-moving news and assess its potential effect on asset prices. The sentiment and relevance scores can be used to enhance predictive models for price movements, support event-driven trading strategies, and diversify signal sources across companies and sectors.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Management and Executive Data
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset provides comprehensive biographical and professional information on board members and senior executives from companies worldwide. It includes details such as employment history, education, achievements, compensation, board roles, committee memberships, and network connections across organizations. The dataset provides factor definitions, cross-sectional rankings, and performance analytics, enabling users to identify key drivers of returns and construct robust, diversified investment models. By systematically evaluating fundamental, technical, and specialty signals, the dataset helps investors uncover persistent sources of excess return and improve portfolio performance through data-driven stock selection and risk management.

The dataset also covers event taxonomy, sentiment scores, relevance, novelty, and aggregation functions, enabling users to link news events to specific entities and analyze their impact. The data includes detailed headlines, descriptions, event categorization, and metadata such as timing, company identifiers, and industry classification. By offering structured, noise-filtered news with intelligent tagging, this dataset enables quantitative models and event-driven strategies to quickly identify and react to market-moving information, making it a valuable resource for predicting short-term price movements and volatility.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: MnA Deals Data

By tracking deal flow, market trends, and competitive dynamics, the dataset enables users to analyze market share, identify comparable transactions, and assess the impact of corporate actions on stock prices. It is highly valuable for predicting price movements around deal announcements, understanding industry consolidation, and constructing event-driven trading strategies.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Significant Developments Data
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset provides concise, real-time summaries of major company news and market-moving events, systematically tagged by topic and significance. Each event is categorized by importance and topic, allowing for integration into quantitative models and historical trend analysis. By tracking and analyzing these significant corporate events, researchers and investors can better anticipate price movements, identify event-driven trading opportunities, and enhance alpha generation strategies.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: News Analytics on Equities

By quantifying the tone and relevance of news, as well as tracking the frequency and uniqueness of coverage, the dataset allows researchers and portfolio managers to assess the potential influence of news flow on price movements, identify momentum or reversal signals, and enhance predictive models for asset returns.

Advanced natural language processing and machine learning models generate analytics like market-moving news probability, sentiment, and novelty scores for each story. By quantifying news impact and sentiment, this dataset enables users to identify market-moving events, gauge investor sentiment, and detect abnormal price movement risks, making it highly valuable for predicting short-term price reactions and supporting event-driven trading strategies.

The dataset provides model outputs such as predicted returns, quantile labels, and associated confidence probabilities for multiple forecast horizons. By leveraging visual patterns in option data, the dataset enables systematic, cross-sectional return predictions and can help identify stocks with favorable risk-reward profiles, making it a valuable tool for quantitative trading and investment strategies focused on price movement forecasting.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Sensitivity to Interest Rates Model
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset provides a machine learning-based model that quantifies the sensitivity of individual stocks to changes in interest rates, using elastic net regression. It includes metrics such as sensitivity to parallel shifts (level) and twists (slope) of the yield curve, derived from principal component analysis of global interest rate data. Covering over 11,000 stocks across 45 countries, the dataset enables investors to assess how monetary policy changes and yield curve movements may impact stock returns. By incorporating these sensitivity measures into portfolio construction and risk management, users can better predict price movements during periods of interest rate volatility and optimize exposure to macroeconomic factors.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset contains the outputs and components of a machine learning-based global stock selection model focused on dividend-paying equities. Leveraging a large factor library and advanced algorithms, it generates composite scores that reflect the expected performance and risk profile of stocks, with specialized sub-models for linear, hedge, and defensive scenarios. The model incorporates contextual information, risk management, and signal persistence metrics, making it highly effective for constructing portfolios that seek stable income and downside protection. By providing predictive signals and risk-adjusted rankings, this dataset is valuable for forecasting price movements, optimizing portfolio returns, and managing risk in dividend-oriented investment strategies.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: NLP on conference conversation
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset applies natural language processing to corporate event transcripts, primarily from earnings calls and other financial conferences, to extract and quantify sentiment. It includes detailed breakdowns by section (presentation, Q&A), speaker, and sentence, providing sentiment scores using dictionary-based matching. The data is cleaned and segmented for ease of use, with meta data and simple sentiment indicators for each event. By analyzing the tone and sentiment of management and analyst interactions, investors can gauge market expectations, management confidence, and potential red flags, making this dataset valuable for predicting short-term price movements and identifying alpha opportunities around key corporate events.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset provides a comprehensive set of network-based momentum signals, constructed from multiple economic and textual networks such as business segments, geographic exposure, analyst coverage, executive links, patent innovation, supply chain, and shipping networks. Enhanced with natural language processing of company filings and EDGAR log-based relationships, the composite model aggregates these diverse factors using a risk parity approach. The resulting signals are designed to be less correlated with traditional momentum, offering improved risk-adjusted returns and lower drawdowns. This dataset is valuable for quantitative investors seeking to predict price movements by capturing complex inter-company relationships and alternative sources of momentum beyond price trends.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Alpha Toolkit Dataset
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset provides robust tools and supporting data for ETF alpha research, including clustering, universe selection, and residual return analysis, enabling researchers to focus on generating excess returns without rebuilding foundational infrastructure.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Financial Opinion Mining
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset focuses on financial opinion mining from various text-based sources such as earnings calls, news, and social media. It aims to extract potential signals by performing deep analysis, considering financial characteristics and correlations among different data sources. The methodology involves advanced feature extraction, sentiment scoring using word embeddings, semi-supervised/transfer learning for adapting sentiment across data, and time-series value prediction through multi-source embedding. The dataset is designed to cover opinion mining tasks including sentiment analysis, company grouping, and value prediction, ultimately seeking to uncover valuable insights from the complete event timeline across diverse text data.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset tracks daily Wikipedia pageviews for companies across a global universe, capturing user interest and information-seeking behavior. By aggregating and transforming raw pageview data into structured fields, it enables researchers to analyze trends in public attention, which can serve as a proxy for retail investor sentiment or information demand. The use of natural days (including weekends and holidays) ensures comprehensive coverage and more robust time series analysis. Spikes or sustained increases in pageviews may precede or coincide with significant price movements, making this dataset valuable for predicting market activity, especially around news events or periods of heightened public interest.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset provides comprehensive news analytics for equities, including over 80 fields across five key categories: relevance, sentiment, novelty, volume, and headline classification. Each news item is scored for every asset it materially mentions, with separate linguistic processing for each asset, such as companies or commodities. The dataset includes granular metadata like timestamps, source, headline tags, and asset identifiers (RIC, PermID), enabling detailed analysis of how news impacts specific securities. By quantifying sentiment, relevance, and novelty, and tracking news volume, this dataset is highly valuable for predicting price movements, identifying market-moving events, and generating alpha signals through systematic news-based strategies.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset captures detailed transaction-level activity from over 81,000 individual retail users, including actions such as opening, closing, and adjusting positions, as well as watchlist modifications. GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Holidays and Trading Hours Calendar
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: The Data Explorers dataset provides comprehensive short interest and securities lending data, sourced from the lending desks of major sell-side institutions and large buy-side players globally. It covers metrics such as lendable inventory, utilization rates, borrow demand, loan values, borrow costs, and proprietary sentiment indicators (e.g., DNS, DIPS, DIMV, DSS) at the security, group, and market level. The dataset includes both end-of-day and intraday feeds, with detailed breakdowns by region, asset class, and contributor type. By tracking the supply and demand dynamics of securities lending, as well as short positioning and borrow costs, this dataset offers valuable insights into market sentiment, short squeeze risk, and crowding. These signals are widely used in quantitative strategies to predict price reversals, identify crowded shorts, manage risk, and enhance alpha generation, making it a critical resource for anticipating price movements driven by short interest and lending market activity.

These factors capture changes in credit conditions, market sentiment, and cross-asset relationships, making the dataset valuable for quantitative models, risk assessment, and alpha generation. Investors and analysts can use these signals to enhance equity selection, construct long-short strategies, and anticipate price movements based on underlying credit market trends.

While not directly predictive of price movements, the dataset is essential for data normalization, aggregation, and the construction of robust multi-source trading and risk models.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Alternate Industry Classification
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset provides an alternative industry classification for global equities, derived from historical stock returns using principal component analysis (PCA) and robust resampling methods. By extracting significant risk factors and grouping securities into clusters of varying sizes, it offers a data-driven approach to industry segmentation across multiple regions and sectors. The dataset includes detailed mappings for top securities and supports flexible cluster sizes, enabling users to analyze market structure, sector rotation, and cross-sectional risk. This classification can enhance factor modeling, portfolio construction, and alpha generation by capturing dynamic relationships between stocks, potentially improving predictions of price movements and risk exposures.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Equity Interval Data

The data is updated weekly and includes both annual and quarterly frequencies, with comprehensive historical coverage. By capturing granular, comparable operational data, this dataset is valuable for quantitative research and can enhance price prediction models by linking company performance drivers to future returns, especially when combined with financial statement and market data.

The data includes returns orthogonal to risk model factors, representing the idiosyncratic or residual component of asset performance. Coverage spans multiple regions and universes, with fields such as Bloomberg ID and specific return percentage. By decomposing total returns into factor-driven and residual parts, this dataset enables researchers and portfolio managers to isolate stock-specific movements, assess alpha generation, and improve risk-adjusted forecasting of price changes.

GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.name: Index Market Data
GLB_MINVOL1M_d1.description: This dataset provides standardized, point-in-time global company fundamental data, including detailed financial statements, per share data, calculated ratios, and pricing information for over 96% of global market capitalization. It offers annual and interim/quarterly data, with 1500+ data items, and is designed for peer comparability across companies and regions. The dataset is valuable for quantitative research and price prediction, as it enables robust cross-sectional and time-series analysis of financial health, valuation, profitability, leverage, and growth metrics, which are key drivers of stock price movements and risk assessment.
